notes.summary: Chunks load on any scope's thread under the runtime's native code policy, the code generator is reachable from a call, templates resolve their imports at load time, and a frame's call site costs two debug fields.
added: `source::LoadScope`, implemented for every scope: `load_bytecode` and `load_source` load a chunk on the scope's own thread, so Luau resolves its builtin imports against that thread's safe globals, and compile it natively according to the runtime's mode, so a `require` written in Rust needs neither the `Runtime` nor `luau_load` by hand.
`NativeCodeGen::for_scope`: the runtime's code generator from a bound function's `Call` or any other scope of its VM.
`DebugScope::call_site`: the chunk name and current line of a frame, asking Luau for those two fields only; Luau records lines, not columns.

Templates load on a loader thread whose globals are the base environment, so Luau resolves their builtin imports when the template loads and every instance takes the fast import path from its first run.
